questions.question: How many students from the ages of 5 to 17 are enrolled at the State Special School school in Fremont for the 2014-2015 academic year?
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.EdOpsCode = 'SSS' AND T2.City = 'Fremont' AND T1.`Academic Year` BETWEEN 2014 AND 2015

questions.question: Of the schools that offers a magnet program serving a grade span of Kindergarten to 8th grade, how many offers Multiple Provision Types? List the number of cities that offers a Kindergarten to 8th grade span and indicate how many schools are there serving such grade span for each city.
questions.evidence: Kindergarten to 8th grade refers to K-8; 'Offers a magnet program' means Magnet = 1; Multiple Provision Types refers to `NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.City, COUNT(T2.CDSCode) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Magnet = 1 AND T2.GSoffered = 'K-8' AND T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' GROUP BY T2.City

questions.question: State the names and full communication address of high schools in Monterey which has more than 800 free or reduced price meals for ages 15-17?
questions.evidence: Full communication address should include Street, City, State and zip code if any.
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.`School Name`, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Monterey' AND T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND T1.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'

questions.question: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT test are exclusively virtual?
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.School) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F' AND T1.AvgScrMath > 400

questions.question: What is the grade span offered in the school with the highest longitude?
questions.evidence: the highest longitude refers to the school with the maximum absolute longitude value.
questions.SQL: SELECT GSoffered FROM schools ORDER BY ABS(longitude) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the valid e-mail addresses of the administrator of the school located in the San Bernardino county, City of San Bernardino City Unified that opened between 1/1/2009 to 12/31/2010 whose school types are public Intermediate/Middle Schools and Unified Schools?
questions.evidence: Intermediate/Middle Schools refers to SOC = 62; Unified School refers to DOC = 54; years between 2009 and 2010 can refer to 'between 1/1/2009 to 12/31/2010'
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.AdmEmail1, T2.AdmEmail2 FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'San Bernardino' AND T2.City = 'San Bernardino' AND T2.DOC = 54 AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) BETWEEN '2009' AND '2010' AND T2.SOC = 62

questions.question: What is the complete address of the school with the lowest excellence rate? Indicate the Street, City, Zip and State.
questions.evidence: Execellence Rate = NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr; complete address has Street, City, State, Zip code
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T1.NumTstTakr ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the average writing score of each of the schools managed by Ricci Ulrich? List the schools and the corresponding average writing scores.
questions.evidence: Usually, administrators manage the school stuff.
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.School, T1.AvgScrWrite FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND T2.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich'

questions.question: What is the eligible free rate of the 10th and 11th schools with the highest enrolment for students in grades 1 through 12?
questions.evidence: K-12 refers to students in grades 1 through 12; Eligible free rate for K-12 = `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)`
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 9, 2

questions.question: What is the monthly average number of schools that opened in Alameda County under the jurisdiction of the Elementary School District in 1980?
questions.evidence: Elementary School District refers to DOC = 52; Monthly average number of schools that opened in 1980 = count(schools that opened in 1980) / 12
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(School) AS REAL) / 12 FROM schools WHERE DOC = 52 AND County = 'Alameda' AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'
